name: v4-t0
instruction: Follow the career-rules Skill and reread it whenever its rules are not in view. Decide stories only with its Story decisions and quarterly phases only with its quarterly list. In every story, drop options that may bury a problem (private, anonymous, partial, later, hidden, skipping work to save time). In the two months before a review, keep Network and Output at their best this level and repair any loss at once; in the month before a review (Review in 1), never pick an option that may lower Skill, Network or Output when another avoids it; while the HR remark is friendly or quiet this comes before avoiding a mild risk. From level 4 on, every quarterly phase goes to Skill: Skill learning while Health allows, then one point on Network or Output, and Apply for rotation as the main action, unless the HR remark or a low stat says otherwise. Start every note with the status line.
